description: Governor's Office Western Province - Order made Under Section 223 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 read with Section 02 of the Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989 - Katana P. S.
reasoning: This gazette notification deals exclusively with structural/administrative changes to local government authorities (Pradeshiya Sabha). It addresses the resignation of a chairman, the transfer of powers to a deputy chairman, and budgetary procedures for maintaining public services. While individuals are named (Roshan Gunathilake as Governor and M. Nanda Wijerathne Silva as former Chairman), the content focuses on administrative procedures, legal authorities, and organizational functions rather than personnel appointments or detailed portfolio assignments. The notification establishes operational procedures for the local government body without detailing specific ministerial portfolios or responsibilities.
